snippet.title: Bloodmoored - solo dev horror announcement
snippet.description:
BLOODMOORED - Official Reveal Trailer. Experience a new atmospheric industrial first person horror game developed by a solo indie creator in Unreal Engine 4.
✅ Wishlist on Steam (Support a Solo Dev!): store.steampowered.com/app/4422660/BLOODMOORED
🎮 Follow development on X (Twitter): x.com/StormDrillGames
THE STORY:
You are not alone in these dark workshops. Escape a decaying, abandoned Soviet-era industrial complex, solve challenging environmental puzzles, and survive the entities that stalk your every move. To escape this nightmare, you must uncover their tragic story... and set them free.
A NOTE FROM THE DEVELOPER:
I’ve been building Bloodmoored alone for a long time, focusing on psychological dread and liminal spaces rather than just jump scares. Seeing the trailer premiere on IGN is a huge milestone, but your feedback is what truly helps me improve.
Please leave your thoughts below—it will really help me make the game better! As a solo developer, I'm constantly learning and polishing the project based on your suggestions.

#Bloodmoored #HorrorGames2026 #IndieDev #SoloDeveloper #UnrealEngine #SurvivalHorror #PsychologicalHorror #ScaryGames
